claims.quote: Axelrod's cory, Hoplisoma axelrodi, long known as Corydoras axelrodi, is an armoured catfish apparently endemic to the Río Meta drainage in Colombia, a tributary of the Orinoco.
Type locality is 'Río Meta, Colombia', and this species is apparently endemic to that drainage although precise locality details are scarce.
